name: GoGo VR - Hide and Seek
summary:
GoGo is an exciting, fast-paced arcade game that challenges your reflexes and timing skills. With simple one-tap controls and increasingly difficult obstacles, every second counts as you dash forward in a vibrant, ever-changing world.

Your goal is simple: survive as long as you can while dodging obstacles, making split-second decisions, and collecting points to rise on the leaderboard.
